description: An invalid key and an invalid hash name together give the JWK import error (ADR 0057 §2: import first, then the hash name): the key is the off-curve P-256 point of reject-p256-off-curve.json (InvalidKey, ADR 0041 §4), checked off-curve with node:crypto (Node v24.21.0, OpenSSL 3.5.8), conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/thumbprints.mjs, and the name "SHA-1" alone gives UnsupportedAlgorithm (hash-reject-upper-sha-1.json, ADR 0054 §8.2)
